question: Does the compressed geometry or the C4 predictor limit performance?

same CPU LightGBM with 31 inputs plus 128 ordered terrain clearances

promotion_logic: Compare same sampled DEV pixels first, then evaluate complete DEV maps for a convincing candidate. Stop an unhelpful branch, diagnose it and continue the overall task. No blind extra epochs, no automatic end of overall work after a branch gate.
GPU_policy: GPU-9a72820b-a8c2-0a94-2297-4f65afc67eb0 only; currently occupied by unrelated hw work, use CPU for this contrast.
comparison_limit: The 31-scalar point learner uses a subset of the C4 image-field information and fewer sampled supervised pixels. A positive result identifies recoverable error; a negative result does not establish input insufficiency. The summary-vs-profile contrast holds point sampling and learner settings fixed.
